question.problem:
Find the coordinates of the vector $x$ relative to the basis $B=\{{b}_{1},{b}_{2},{b}_{3}\},$ where

$$
{b}_{1}=[\begin{aligned}0 \\ 0 \\ 1\end{aligned}],\,{b}_{2}=[\begin{aligned}0 \\ 1 \\ 0\end{aligned}],\,{b}_{3}=[\begin{aligned}1 \\ 0 \\ 0\end{aligned}],\,x=[\begin{aligned}7 \\ -6 \\ -5\end{aligned}].
$$

If $[x]_{B}=[\begin{aligned}{x}_{1} \\ {x}_{2} \\ {x}_{3}\end{aligned}]$ then what is the value of ${x}_{3}?$
question.worked_solution:
Remember, the order of the vectors in a basis is important.

Notice that 

$$
{{[\begin{aligned}7 \\ -6 \\ -5\end{aligned}]}_{⏟}}_{x}={{(\,-5\,)}_{⏟}}_{{x}_{1}}\cdot {{[\begin{aligned}0 \\ 0 \\ 1\end{aligned}]}_{⏟}}_{{b}_{1}}+{{(\,-6\,)}_{⏟}}_{{x}_{2}}\cdot {{[\begin{aligned}0 \\ 1 \\ 0\end{aligned}]}_{⏟}}_{{b}_{2}}+{{(\,7\,)}_{⏟}}_{{x}_{3}}\cdot {{[\begin{aligned}1 \\ 0 \\ 0\end{aligned}]}_{⏟}}_{{b}_{3}}
$$

which means that

$$
x=(-5)\cdot {b}_{1}+(-6)\cdot {b}_{2}+7\cdot {b}_{3}
$$

and therefore

$$
[x]_{B}=[\begin{aligned}-5 \\ -6 \\ 7\end{aligned}],
$$

Finally, ${x}_{3}=7.$
